card.text: Ten-Jupiter-mass planet whose day side JWST mapped at 25 wavelengths, each seeing a different depth.

sources.label: Challener, Weiner Mansfield et al. 2025
sources.quote: Here we present a spectroscopic eclipse map of an extrasolar planet, resolving the atmosphere in multiple dimensions simultaneously.

introduction.text: WASP-18b circles its star in under a day. JWST's eclipse map finds a hotspot under its star and a colder ring near the edges of its day side.

sources.label: Challener, Weiner Mansfield et al. 2025
sources.quote: a “hotspot” surrounding the substellar point and a “ring” near the dayside limbs
